text:
emma: Heads up — getting multiple reports that pages from incidentbot aren't reaching oncall. ~4 missed pages in the last 10m. incidentbot logs show 503s from /notify/send. anyone else seeing 5xx?
ops-bot: incident created INC-1023 | severity: P2 | auto-pages suppressed due to 5xx from /notify/send
raj: seeing the same in prod-us-east. sample log: `ERROR 503 POST /notify/send - upstream timeout (x-ray: x-93a1)`
tina: confirmed — oncall didn't get phone pages, only slack thread alerts. jamal can you do a manual page to verify phone route?
jamal: manual SMS sent to oncall, they acked within 90s. :thumbsup:
emma: thanks. quick mitigation plan: flip fallback flag to force SMS fallback + restart incidentbot v2 pods. I'll start the rollout.
raj: copying logs while you restart. suspect notify-proxy mux exhaustion — threads pegged.
emma: running rolling restart now:
```
kubectl -n infra rollout restart deploy/incidentbot-v2
kubectl -n infra get pods -l app=incidentbot -w
```
ops-bot: deploybot: rollout started for incidentbot-v2 (namespace: infra)
raj: restart started — pods terminating then coming up, healthchecks still flapping on 1 of 3 replicas. seeing intermittent 502 and 503 from notify-proxy during pod churn.
tina: I toggled feature-flag `notify_proxy.fallback_sms=true` in prod config. hoping that routes around the mux.
jamal: confirmed new pages routed via sms-relay — I see 200s to /sms/send in incidentbot logs. oncall getting repeat test pages.
emma: good. we still see a subset of 502/503 from notify-proxy for older connections. looks like a pool leak in mux layer.
raj: digging into notify-proxy metrics — worker_queue_wait time spiked, connection_count per worker at max. opening infra ticket INF-778 to increase worker pool and add alerting on accept queue length.
tina: for customer-impact: some customers with webhook-based paging had delayed escalation ~6-12 minutes; two customers filed support tickets citing missed phone pages. no inference customer downtime, but alerting path degraded.
emma: assign owners: raj -> infra follow-up and fix, tina -> ops post-check and config change review, jamal -> comms to affected customers + summarize support tickets. I'll drive the postmortem.
incidentbot: (system) incidentbot: suppressed pages resumed after remediation (debug id x-93a1)
emma: final status: live mitigation completed, pages flowing via SMS fallback and incidentbot responses 200 -> /sms/send. notify-proxy needs a targeted fix (mux threadpool and circuit-breaker). we'll schedule a rolling patch and a follow-up retro. closing live triage.
raj: notes for postmortem: reproduce under load, add circuit-breaker to notify-proxy, shorten suppression window `squelch-5xx-on-notify` so incidentbot falls back faster.
tina: logging: grabbed heap snapshots and connection stacks for notify-proxy (archive: s3://infra-debug/INF-778/).
emma: thanks all. I'll file the postmortem doc and link INF-778. If anyone sees a regression ping here.
jamal: will handle customer comms and update support tickets with timeline.
ops-bot: incident INC-1023 updated -> status: mitigation complete, timeline capture in progress.
summary: Incidentbot paging to notify-proxy produced 5xx causing missed phone pages; SMS fallback and rolling restart mitigated; follow-ups opened: INF-778 for mux threadpool and shorter suppression rule. owners assigned: raj(infra), tina(ops), jamal(comms).
